owner.line: - 2026-09-06 · owner · M2-RULE — the owner's disposition of the M2 audit, given on rebuild/m2/OWNER-RULING-PACK-M2.md v3 (5,579 bytes, sha256 2568a221bfd50138b4ab4d5bd13efbbf46f66a3ad789bb4127255ba10a2269a9, committed at 4e561e5): owner, exact words received in the Codex coordinator task 01a06e0c-39ea-7591-9666-eead44de251c — a user-role annotation selecting "Approve Batch A and all seven recommended choices", then user-role "Continue" — relayed verbatim by Astra with that provenance on 2026-09-06 14:40 UTC; cowork independently verified the pack correspondence (pack bytes/sha and the register's 38 FIX + 7 OWNER RULING split match the relay) and did NOT directly observe the Codex UI; the Message-35 route governs transport only and did not originate this ruling; recorded as the owner's ruling in his own words, not a recommendation and not an inference from the integration Go — the owner may correct it at any time by an appended line. BATCH A APPROVED as one batch — every FIX recommendation of rebuild/m2/AUDIT-REGISTER.md becomes an approved repair direction: D1 APPROVED-FIX · D2 APPROVED-FIX · D3 APPROVED-FIX · D4 APPROVED-FIX · D5 APPROVED-FIX · D6 APPROVED-FIX · D7 APPROVED-FIX · D9 APPROVED-FIX · D11 APPROVED-FIX · D12 APPROVED-FIX · D13 APPROVED-FIX · D14 APPROVED-FIX · D15 APPROVED-FIX · D17 APPROVED-FIX · D18 APPROVED-FIX · D19 APPROVED-FIX · D20 APPROVED-FIX · D21 APPROVED-FIX · D22 APPROVED-FIX · D23 APPROVED-FIX · D24 APPROVED-FIX · D26 APPROVED-FIX · D27 APPROVED-FIX · D28 APPROVED-FIX · D29 APPROVED-FIX · D30 APPROVED-FIX · D31 APPROVED-FIX · D33 APPROVED-FIX · D34 APPROVED-FIX · D35 APPROVED-FIX · D36 APPROVED-FIX · D38 APPROVED-FIX · D39 APPROVED-FIX · D41 APPROVED-FIX · D42 APPROVED-FIX · D43 APPROVED-FIX · D44 APPROVED-FIX · D45 APPROVED-FIX (38). BATCH B — all seven RECOMMENDED answers chosen, each now an approved repair direction with its exact rule: D8 APPROVED-FIX — when last night's sleep is missing, recovery is UNKNOWN and no sleep restriction is applied today; every other recovery check still applies (not carry-forward of the last logged night). D10 APPROVED-FIX — date-only week counts mean 7 CALENDAR days, not 168 elapsed hours. D16 APPROVED-FIX — a 7-day forecast hit requires an eligible weigh-in on the due day or, failing that, the next day (one grace date); with no such reading the forecast is UNGRADED, not a miss; the day arithmetic follows D10. D25 APPROVED-FIX — "protein: good" requires at least one successful day within the current seven-logged-days window before the one-miss allowance applies; a first missed day cannot read "good". D32 APPROVED-FIX — "benefit replicated" counts only sessions from the CURRENT technique; all other replication thresholds stay as they are. D37 APPROVED-FIX — a merged earned receipt keeps the assessment as of the day it was earned, accepting that this can change whether a single-sighting increase counts as earned and the numbers printed on past earned receipts. D40 APPROVED-FIX — when two phones disagree on a day's calories with equal detail, ONE deterministic shared winner is chosen with the conflict kept visible and BOTH original entries retained; the exact tie-break rule and how the conflict is shown are NOT decided here and must be specified in the reviewed fix brief before anything is built. Totals: 45/45 dispositions recorded, 45 APPROVED-FIX, 0 KEEP, 0 DEFER, 0 UNRULED. What this does NOT do: it approves directions, not code — each theme still needs its accepted behaviour/delta brief, its red-first laws turning GREEN on the candidate and RED on the frozen engine, the post-fix gate's PACKAGE run and cowork's execution acceptance; the frozen app and its goldens stay untouched; no private release, spending, phone gate, remote gate or M2 closure is waived; no owner-specific interval or value is set. Transport: the route ruling at line 42 applies; no additional Go was requested or given · rebuild/m2/OWNER-RULING-PACK-M2.md · M2-RULE DONE; M2-FIX unblocked for briefs (D33–D35 first, per the accepted PR #34 contract)

PRE-IMAGE RE-VERIFICATION IS THE LANE’S, NOT THE TOOLING FIXER’S: the product pre-images in this spec are the parent’s own pins carried forward. This package’s lane re-verifies them, and re-takes them if the engine moves under it, at seal time — nothing here is an independent measurement of the lane’s work.

coverage.moves is {} and must stay {} (TOOLING-REVIEW-r3 X1): the runner refuses any non-empty moves while MOVES_RULING is absent, in spec() and again at the seal in envelope(). That is what closes r3’s R3-A — the move/needle composite reaches nothing at all when no move can be declared, rather than being narrowly bounded.

parent.options[].reviewSha256 pins the parent’s REVIEW file by bytes, and option() additionally requires the receipt base that review names to be an ancestor of refs/remotes/origin/rebuild/t2-client-core — resolved from Git refs, never from this spec (TOOLING-REVIEW-r3 X2, closing R3-B).

SINGLE PARENT, TWO WAYS (TOOLING-REVIEW-r4 Y2). parent.chosen is null here, so the rule is not yet engaged. When the PM names one, parent() refuses if any sibling packages/*.json claims the same artifact — read BOTH from disk AND from Git at HEAD, so freeing a sibling’s `chosen` in an uncommitted edit no longer frees the parent (r4 G14) — and refuses again if an already-sealed rebuild/m4/spec/acceptance-*.json ON refs/remotes/origin/rebuild/t2-client-core names it. Practical consequence for this spec: B-NTC already claims acceptance-native-carriers.json in Git at HEAD, so B1 naming NATIVE-CARRIERS refuses until the PM moves one of them; B2 is the other option and is not sealed.
